transformation.description: Per asset: derive facing from the whole Head-to-Hip heading vector and snap to the nearest quarter turn (rigged only), apply any authored yaw, scale uniformly to the stated target along the stated axis, optionally fit the recorded architectural envelope within a 20 percent axis limit, re-origin to bottom centre through a Pivot node so a skin binding survives, resample source maps to each asset table entry texture size (512 by default) in JPEG, force the metallic factor to zero, and rename material, mesh and textures semantically.

rebuild.construction: One gate section: a folded double-sided sheet traced in plan, flat panels at z 0 from each heel reveal turning up at the mitre into a meeting ridge (a stile with its closed joint on the apex upstream, the seam groove downstream); heel stiles flush with the post faces on both faces abutting the post inner face, joined to the panel by one through-reveal; all capped by a head band closed on both faces from the seat to the deck soffit as two planes per face meeting at the mitre, flush with the post faces at the posts, with a pocket at each downstream heel for the balance beam and lever directly above the flush stile; one 4 m box-section timber beam with square ends lapped onto the west post face and bearing on the deck soffit.
rebuild.pairedRuntimeGearEnclosed: The paddle housings, spindles and handwheels stand inside the closed head band and are not visible from outside; no drawn triangle enters them.
rebuild.droppedHiddenFaces: post tops (inside the deck), post bottoms (on the ground)

geometryRefinement.finalStageOrder: Immutable prepared source; legacy sizing, normalization and indexing; generator-only canonicalization; arm-index removal and paired origin; post footings grounded; leaves, head band and beam rebuilt on the freed rows. Never normalize the final body again.
